FRONT: [Tools] How can you tell a file has an ACL from ls -l?
BACK: A + at the end of the permission string (e.g. -rw-r--r--+)

FRONT: [Tools] View the ACLs on a file
[Tools] Give user bob read+write on a file via ACL
[Tools] Remove one ACL entry / all ACLs from a file
[Tools] Make new files in a directory inherit an ACL
BACK: setfacl -m d:u:bob:rw dir (d: = default ACL, applies to newly created files)
